law_status: exact finite rational laws; no Monte Carlo approximation
scope: Bounded exact replay of two examples; not production reference code or solver.

cases.interpretation: Deleting one correct direction leaves one error among fewer disclosures. Positive-threshold tail and expected-FDP feasibility fail; zero-tail risk stays equal. Risk rises because a correct direction is replaced by paid withholding.

cases.action_family: full Cartesian product of canonical ordered partitions for n=2; exactly 9 actions
cases.equality_guards: singleton classes only; no latent equality in support
cases.interpretation: Relaxing alpha expands feasibility and lowers optimal risk, yet the unique minimizer loses a grade in domain 1. Total I and occupied C remain unchanged; neither selected action is a pure coarsening of the other.

validation_code.scope: Exact replay of bounded fixtures only.
validation_code.entrypoint: Load JSON as fixture; exec(validation_code.source) in a namespace containing fixture; read validation_summary.
validation_code.source:
from fractions import Fraction as Q
from itertools import combinations, product
checks=[]
def equal(actual,expected,label):
    assert actual==expected,(label,actual,expected)
    checks.append(label)
def directions(G,d):
    return {(i,j) for i in range(len(G)) for j in range(len(G)) if i!=j and G[i][d]<G[j][d]}
def evaluate(case,G,thresholds=None):
    n,D=case['n'],case['D']
    M=n*(n-1)//2
    weights=list(map(Q,case['w']))
    tau=list(map(Q,case['tau']))
    t=list(map(Q,case['thresholds'] if thresholds is None else thresholds))
    N=[len(directions(G,d)) for d in range(D)]
    F=[]
    masses=[]
    for state in case['states']:
        masses.append(Q(state['mass']))
        F.append([sum(state['Theta'][i][d]<=state['Theta'][j][d] for i,j in directions(G,d)) for d in range(D)])
    assert sum(masses)==1 and sum(weights)==1
    risk=sum(mass*sum(weights[d]*(errors[d]+tau[d]*(M-N[d]))/M for d in range(D)) for mass,errors in zip(masses,F))
    J=sum(mass for mass,errors in zip(masses,F) if any(errors[d]>t[d]*N[d] for d in range(D)))
    mean=[sum(mass*errors[d] for mass,errors in zip(masses,F)) for d in range(D)]
    return dict(M=M,N=N,F_by_state=F,FDP_by_state=[[Q(errors[d],N[d]) if N[d] else None for d in range(D)] for errors in F],risk=risk,J=J,mean=mean,K=[len({row[d] for row in G}) for d in range(D)],I=sum(N),C=len({tuple(row) for row in G}))
def pure_coarsening(new,old):
    for d in range(len(old[0])):
        mapping={}
        for x,y in zip(old,new):
            if x[d] in mapping and mapping[x[d]]!=y[d]:return False
            mapping[x[d]]=y[d]
        seq=[mapping[k] for k in sorted(mapping)]
        if seq!=sorted(seq) or set(seq)!=set(range(1,max(seq)+1)):return False
    return True
c=fixture['cases'][0]
old=evaluate(c,c['G'])
new=evaluate(c,c['G_coarse'])
for label,actual in [('original',old),('coarse',new)]:
    ex=c['expected'][label]
    for key in ['M','N','F_by_state']:equal(actual[key],ex[key],label+' '+key)
    for key in ['risk','J']:equal(actual[key],Q(ex[key]),label+' '+key)
    equal(actual['FDP_by_state'],[[Q(v) for v in row] for row in ex['FDP_by_state']],label+' fractions')
    equal([actual['mean'][d]<=Q(c['expected_cap'][d])*actual['N'][d] for d in range(c['D'])],ex['expected_constraint_satisfied'],label+' mean constraint')
equal(pure_coarsening(c['G_coarse'],c['G']),True,'adjacent pure coarsening')
old_dirs=directions(c['G'],0)
new_dirs=directions(c['G_coarse'],0)
equal(new_dirs<=old_dirs,True,'issued directions are only deleted')
equal(sorted([[i+1,j+1] for i,j in old_dirs-new_dirs]),c['expected']['removed_directed_pairs_one_based'],'removed pairs')
equal(sorted([[i+1,j+1] for i,j in new_dirs]),c['expected']['retained_directed_pairs_one_based'],'retained pairs')
for label,G in [('original',c['G']),('coarse',c['G_coarse'])]:
    equal(evaluate(c,G,['0'])['J'],Q(c['expected']['zero_threshold_J_'+label]),'zero threshold '+label)
equal(c['G_coarse'] in c['restricted_candidate_bank'],c['expected']['candidate_bank_closed_under_this_coarsening'],'candidate closure failure')
equal(new['F_by_state'][0][0]<=old['F_by_state'][0][0],True,'pointwise error count nonincrease')
equal(new['N'][0]<=old['N'][0],True,'disclosure count nonincrease')
equal(new['J']>old['J'],True,'positive-threshold tail increase')
c=fixture['cases'][1]
canonical=[list(g) for g in product(range(1,c['n']+1),repeat=c['n']) if set(g)==set(range(1,max(g)+1))]
equal(sorted(canonical),sorted(c['column_codes'].values()),'complete n=2 canonical columns')
lookup={tuple(g):label for label,g in c['column_codes'].items()}
results={}
matrices={}
for cols in product(canonical,repeat=c['D']):
    label=''.join(lookup[tuple(col)] for col in cols)
    G=[list(row) for row in zip(*cols)]
    matrices[label]=G
    results[label]=evaluate(c,G)
equal(len(results),9,'full product enumeration has nine actions')
equal(set(results),{row['id'] for row in c['expected_actions']},'expected rows cover family')
for row in c['expected_actions']:
    value=results[row['id']]
    for key in ['risk','J']:equal(value[key],Q(row[key]),row['id']+' '+key)
    for key in ['K','I','C']:equal(value[key],row[key],row['id']+' '+key)
    for budget in ['low','high']:
        equal(value['J']<=Q(c['alpha_'+budget]),row['feasible_'+budget],row['id']+' feasible '+budget)
for budget in ['low','high']:
    feasible=[key for key,v in results.items() if v['J']<=Q(c['alpha_'+budget])]
    best=min(results[key]['risk'] for key in feasible)
    opts=[key for key in feasible if results[key]['risk']==best]
    equal(sorted(feasible),sorted(c['expected_feasible_'+budget]),'feasible set '+budget)
    equal(sorted(opts),sorted(c['expected_optimal_'+budget]),'complete optimum set '+budget)
    equal(best,Q(c['expected_minimum_risk_'+budget]),'optimal risk '+budget)
    equal(results[opts[0]]['K'],c['expected_selected_K_'+budget],'selected grades '+budget)
equal(set(c['expected_feasible_low'])<=set(c['expected_feasible_high']),True,'nested feasible sets')
equal(Q(c['expected_minimum_risk_high'])<Q(c['expected_minimum_risk_low']),True,'strict risk improvement')
equal(c['expected_selected_K_high'][0]<c['expected_selected_K_low'][0],True,'domain 1 loses grade')
for a,b in [('PW','WP'),('WP','PW')]:equal(pure_coarsening(matrices[a],matrices[b]),False,a+' not coarsening of '+b)
equal(results['PW']['I'],results['WP']['I'],'no disclosure-count decrease claim')
equal(results['PW']['C'],results['WP']['C'],'no occupied-cell decrease claim')
validation_summary={'status':'passed','assertions':len(checks),'case_count':len(fixture['cases']),'enumerated_product_actions':len(results),'arithmetic':'fractions.Fraction; exact','check_labels':checks}
